detail: Backtest must write daily equity evidence.
Rebalance rows are required for turnover and T+1 traceability.
No trades can be valid for tiny samples, but it is not enough for strategy validation.
Fees, taxes, and slippage-cost proxy must be present and non-negative.
Strategy validation must use cost-after backtest metrics.
Average realized turnover should respect the configured turnover budget.
Drawdown outside the risk budget is evidence against deployment.
A strategy that only works in aggregate should remain challenged by year.
Extreme bad years require separate explanation.
Constraint report and daily summary must be written.
Single-name exposure cap must hold after constraints.
Theme exposure cap must hold after constraints.
Daily target turnover cap must hold after constraints.
News-aware portfolio runs must write event attribution evidence.
News-aware portfolio runs should record event-risk guard metadata.
Free-source capacity is approximate, so the audit requires traded value and cost-bps evidence.
